name: BridgeTopia
description: BridgeTopia's extension, search and export deals to BridgeTopia
comment_icons: Four sizes of one drawing, resampled from the 128 with sips rather than left to Chrome: the toolbar draws it at 16 and letting the browser scale a 128 down that far turns the BT monogram to mush. 16/32 are the toolbar, 48 is chrome://extensions, 128 is the install prompt.
comment_hosts: Two hosts, both required, both granted at install: BBO, where the listing needs the user's own session, and the one BridgeTopia server every user of this build imports into — the same string as SERVER in src/worker.js. No wildcards and no optional origins: the address is fixed at build time, so there is nothing for the user to type and nothing to request at runtime.

content_scripts.comment: One entry for the whole host, because same-origin is a property of the origin and not of the path — the popup only needs *some* logged-in BBO tab to run its fetches in. There is nothing on any page, so nothing here cares which page it is. It used to be two entries, hands.php with a download bar of its own plus everything-else without it, which needed exclude_matches to stop parse.js being evaluated twice in one isolated world; one entry cannot collide with itself.
